correctness.rationale: The definition is induced connected components of cardinality at most two, not ordinary independence. Independent reconstruction from the two coordinate adjacency rules checked all 65,536 subsets each, obtaining f-vectors (16,120,384,528,144) for the rook graph and (16,120,384,544,240,32) for Shrikhande. Applying the actual two vertex orders produces respectively 543 and 639 disjoint element-matching pairs, leaving one critical vertex and 105 or 57 critical three-faces; constructing all 4,224 or 4,960 Hasse covers and topologically sorting the reversed-matching orientation establishes acyclicity. Forman discrete Morse then gives integral wedge homotopy, not merely mod-two Betti ranks. No all-strongly-regular-graph generalization follows.
